The wealth comparison indicated by the first Eikhah pointer remains open. The identified midrash under this verse gives the Charsena variant in a list. The towns-and-ships account is explicit in Yoma.

The mystical identification and gematria are preserved in the named work’s voice; exact edition/locus remains open. Searched the work and headword and read the separate Bavli evidence. No passage was promoted on a secondary match.

Heilprin’s short Hillel pointer could refer to the neighboring typological comparison or the mystical context. Yoma 35b directly juxtaposes the exemplars Hillel and Elazar. That does not establish the intended internal locus for this parenthetical pointer.
The Antigonus dating and relationship between Charsom and Charsena remain qualified. Yoma’s enumeration and the variant Eikhah list are both retained without harmonizing the chronology.
